title: nf-core/virulencemge pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fasta.errorMessage: Nucleotide genome assembly FASTA must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fasta', '.fas', '.fa', '.fna' or '.fsa' (optionally '.gz' compressed)

gff.errorMessage: Annotation GFF cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.gff' or '.gff3' (optionally '.gz' compressed). Leave the column empty if not available.

gbk.errorMessage: Annotation GenBank file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.gbk', '.gb', '.gbf' or '.gbff' (optionally '.gz' compressed). Leave the column empty if not available.

faa.errorMessage: Protein FASTA cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.faa', '.fasta' or '.fa' (optionally '.gz' compressed). Leave the column empty if not available.

errorMessage.anyOf: At least one of 'gbk' or 'gff' must be provided. PhiSpy and IslandPath-DIMOB both require GenBank input; when only 'gff' is given the pipeline builds a GenBank file from 'gff' + 'fasta'.
